before: ReflectionClass and ReflectionMethod expose declared structure. getMethod("run") finds the named method, and isPublic reports its visibility. This does not invoke run or prove that calling it with arbitrary input is safe.

Reflection is useful for tools and explicit metadata frameworks, not a reason to expose arbitrary method names from an untrusted request. The example examines a known local class and prints one Boolean label only.
